name: What is the typical cost to insulate exterior walls in Huntington Beach?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost to insulate exterior walls in Huntington Beach?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to insulate exterior walls in Huntington Beach varies based on several factors, including the type of insulation material, the total square footage of the walls, and the complexity of the installation process. Blown-in insulation might range from $1.50 to $3.00 per square foot, while spray foam can be $3.00 to $7.00 per square foot or more. These figures generally include labor and materials. Getting a detailed estimate from a local contractor is essential for an accurate cost tailored to your specific home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary by material and square footage, typically ranging from $1.50-$3.00/sq ft for blown-in and $3.00-$7.00/sq ft for spray foam in Huntington Beach. Obtain a local estimate for accuracy.
